body:
[Erowid Note: 
Cannabis substitute "spice" type smoking blends, "Bath salts", "plant food", "incense", "tea" and similar products generally do not accurately list psychoactive ingredients or dosage on their packaging. Analysis has revealed that ingredients in a single product of this type may vary over time. The component chemical(s) may be different than what is assumed for this report.]
My previous experiences have been with MDMA, 4-MEC, 4-MMC, Cannabis/THC, alcohol, and kratom.
I decided to see what all the fuss is with 'bath salts' and finally got some MDPV. I am not sure if it is real MDPV so take that into consideration.
Hours:minutes
0:00 measured 5mg and chopped it down to an ultrafine powder, appears a bit brown/tan and smells similar to cum after being in a condom for a day.  Snorts easily with a very small amount of burn and a slight drip.
0:05 starting to worry if took enough but know not to redose based on other reports.
0:10 definite chemical smell and slightly bitter drip only things noticed so far.  Starting to worry it's not MDPV.
0:11 just noticed heartrate went up slightly and forehead feels slightly warmer.
0:15 still feel slightly warm, mild teeth clench, drip still there.
0:20 noticed nose started to be a bit runny. Body slightly shakey.  Notice slight tingling in toes and cheeks.
0:25 sounds seem to be slightly enhanced but still not feeling much except for bad taste in mouth, drank some water and it goes away quickly.
0:30 decide to take another 5mg, notice a bit more of the smell this time and feel need to sniff in through nose and out through mouth.
0:40 felt some ever so slight clearness and feel slightly shaky.
0:45 feeling bored and suspect do not have real MDPV.
1:00 decide to try more 10mgs.
1:05 same drip same smell not much else.
1:20 very mild tingles and fingers slightly jittery, just like if you drank a couple cups of coffee on an empty stomach.
1:30 okay till not feeling much of anything, going for 100mgs.
1:30 snorted 100mgs much more drip and chemical taste, smell is not as bad.
1:40 feeling slightly more awake.
2:00 feeling slightly light headed, this stuff sucks compared to every other chem I've tried.
2:30 tried 100mg more, nose very runny after this one.
2:55 just slight jitters and that is about it.
4:00 start to destroy remainder, don't want to try any further.
5:30 slight flushed feeling and jitters still there but nothing more.
5:35 feel a slight headache, nose slightly congested.
7:00 seem to be back to baseline, body slightly sweaty now notice feet feel cold / vasoconstriction is happening.
8:00 feet still cold but feel normal, going to bed.
16:00 woke up, slight disoriented feeling of blah / slight depression. Felt this was stupid and don't see what all the fuss is over it.
